newsitem.title: LATVIA: LNT TO BUY STATE'S STAKE IN LASAM-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: LNT TO BUY STATE'S STAKE IN LASAM-REPORT.

text.p: Latvijas Naftas Tranzits (LNT) shareholders have agreed to buy the state's stake in pipeline operator Lasam, the Dienas bizness newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The privatisation agency's rules for Lasam's sell-off were approved on May 13. The price of one Lasam share is 3,401 lats, the newspaper reported.
The state controls 89.86 percent of Lasam or 21,401 shares worth an estimated 72.8 million lats.
The newspaper reports that 55 percent of the sum has to be paid in cash and 45 percent in vouchers.
LNT was formed in 1995 by six local oil transit companies with the aim of participating in the Lasam and Venstspils Nafta sell-offs.
